purpose: Time-bounded model-convergence observations. A tell is weak evidence and never a universal style prohibition.

tells.observed_pattern: Decorative clipped-gradient headline treatment repeatedly appears as a default identity substitute without subject or brand causality.
tells.falsifier: The committed product or brand direction proves the gradient material is a subject-specific signature and rendered critique confirms it strengthens hierarchy rather than replacing it.

tells.observed_pattern: Many unrelated regions are repeatedly enclosed in visually equivalent rounded cards, making containment stand in for hierarchy or product structure.
tells.falsifier: Each repeated boundary maps to an independently meaningful object, state, interaction or containment contract and alternative grouping would reduce product truth or operability.

tells.observed_pattern: Pills and badges accumulate as decorative emphasis across headings, feature lists and metadata even when they communicate no state, category or actionable meaning.
tells.falsifier: The pill or badge consistently represents an explicit state, filter, category or interaction contract whose shape improves scanning or control semantics.
